22996-T1

Type-1 Zoning Map Amendment
For 3043 N Ashland Ave, Chicago, IL 60657
From B3-2 Community Shopping District to B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District

1.A. The applicant seeks a zoning change from a B3-2 Community Shopping District
to that of a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District to meet the bulk and density
standards of the B2-3 zoning district to allow the applicants to convert the
existing ground floor commercial space to a residential unit. The property will
remain a 3-story building with a basement and attached 2-car garage with 3
dwelling units, no commercial space, and the approximate height of 33°-3” will
remain unchanged.
